title: The tubes
content: The first dreams that I remember ever having were like the mall world without as much stimuli input. I started having these dreams at a very young age and they were recurring dreams for years. I had dreams of wandering through white rooms that were interconnected by portals ok all sides. In the center of every room there was a single item. The portals were like playground tubes but also reminded me of that stage in Legend of Zelda OOT where you're looking for the Forest Temple and have to move from stage to stage through dark vortexes. I had a sense of dread that was intense and every time I came to a room with a rose I would hear a screaming from the inside of a tube and I was kicked out. I mention this because I have been having more and more mallworld dreams and it's becoming apparent to me that the mallworld feels like an advanced sensory version of this place. I want to know if anyone else has been to the tubes and has experience with them. I've spent my life puzzling over those dreams and want to see if I can get some input.
